leadText: Volume 1 is the first volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.
plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished. 

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
An X-cuse to Come Out and Play
X-actly What They Wanted
Inn-teresting Developments
They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping
Kangaskhan...Kangascan't
The Aegislash Agenda
Lucky Lucario Was Here
